reported_numbers_match_json retired (2026-10-11): Zero-Hallucination is graded by the runner-side report-vs-JSON differ (tests/evals/report_diff.py diffing reports/report_{SYMBOL}_{DATE}.html against the record's own JSON) instead of a dataset boolean; a record without a generated stage-12 report stays ungraded.

html_report_valid retired (2026-10-11): HTML Visualizer validity is graded by the runner reading the stage-12 artifact itself (gate_html_validity in tests/run_evals.py validating reports/report_{SYMBOL}_{DATE}.html for HTML5 doctype, zero external resources, self-contained styling and inline SVG) instead of a dataset boolean; a record without a generated stage-12 report stays ungraded.

input echo retired (2026-10-12): the hand-typed script_outputs['current_trade.json'] = {'type': 'FUT', 'instrument_type': 'FUT'} stub every one of the 31 seeded records carried is removed. It was redundant and contradictory, not evidence: the only reader was gate 1's option-instrument probe, which falls back to the record's own `instrument` field, while the stage-12 replay is fed the proof row's recorded_artifacts and its pinned replay_inputs.canonical_trade — and 36 of the proof root's 46 canonical fixtures state instrument_type CASH, so the stub asserted a value the recorded input contradicts. Retiring it restores the E1 rule it violated (a payload a gate reads must be a recording, never an extracted subset typed into the dataset), and tests/run_evals.py check_payload_coverage fails the run on any payload a record carries with no recorded artifact behind it. Curators must not write it back (tests/evals/curate.py, tests/evals/pin_legacy_records.py).
